subject: RUN-KIC-8b5038 finite fresh-target K=75 capacity-only direct/rho comparison
claim_ceiling: Review may validate or reject only an exact finite public-synthetic observation at the declared source, host, targets, process and resource boundary. It cannot establish asymptotic advantage, SOTA, security impact, or cryptanalytic break.

coordinator_prior.expectation: Doubling a 94%-occupied signed-expanded table may reduce probing cost, but the direct memory increase may offset wall benefit and rho may remain faster. Parent non-confirmation gives no basis to expect the candidate/rho predicate passes.

evidence.reference: parent internal K=75 table occupancy record
evidence.scope: measured occupancy, not a capacity-performance measurement

review_setup.snapshot_prerequisite: TASK-20260921-c8973d hash-binds parent review readback, sources/binaries, case/analyzer/runner closure, preflight controls, raw process index/archive, analysis, and environment before reviewer access.

blindness.attestation_required: Reviewer attests it read this plan and snapshot, not an unlisted report from this round.

joints.load_bearing_step: Parent review validated the evidence needed to open this successor, and direct baseline/candidate differ only by doubling CompactPairTable capacity when x_only=true.
joints.attack_plan: Check parent-review readback against prerequisite; recompute source/binary hashes; inspect candidate diff for changes to field math, density, Bloom expected-value logic, target generation, witness policy, threads, rho, CLI/dataflow, or undisclosed allocation behavior.
joints.coordinator_expected_break: A mechanically adjacent allocation or backend change could be carried in with the declared capacity delta.

joints.load_bearing_step: N=13 controls establish common base/domain/lookup semantics and actual common ARM PMULL use without falsely requiring equal hash-sensitive traces.
joints.attack_plan: Check N=13 receipts, base/point/label/domain/lookup fields, group identities, x_only capacity condition, and actual backend. Confirm different witness order, first-hit transcript, or rank prefix alone was not treated as failure.
joints.coordinator_expected_break: Slot ordering could change active-domain semantics, or an arm could fall back from the required backend.

joints.load_bearing_step: 24 exact deterministic targets are parent-disjoint and all 72 children ran once in the frozen balanced order, fresh and state-free.
joints.attack_plan: Regenerate scalars/seeds; check parent disjointness; verify six permutations repeat four times and positions balance eight per arm; trace directories/logs/process lifetimes for reuse.
joints.coordinator_expected_break: A collision, reordering, or inherited artifact could create an apparent capacity effect.

joints.load_bearing_step: Each included process has correct known answer/group identity and whole wall to wait4 reap, per-PID CPU/RSS, polling method, and cap/watchdog outcome.
joints.attack_plan: Check raw entries and receipt hashes; sample correctness; verify wait4 defines wall end; reject aggregate RUSAGE_CHILDREN RSS as per-process telemetry; detect omitted/retried/cap-reached entries.
joints.coordinator_expected_break: The larger table may alter memory/process-end accounting and make wall change look free.

joints.load_bearing_step: Candidate/rho primary ratio/bootstrap use all 24 fresh pairs; candidate/baseline wall/CPU/RSS are secondary and memory remains visible.
joints.attack_plan: Before producer analysis, recompute all 24 ratios, median, and deterministic 10000-resample interval from raw receipts; separately compute candidate/baseline secondary values and inspect each RSS raw field/unit/method.
joints.coordinator_expected_break: Subset selection, omitted failure, or wall-only reporting could manufacture a signal or conceal the capacity cost.

joints.load_bearing_step: Any conclusion remains capacity-specific and finite.
joints.attack_plan: Swap candidate/rho labels in the report logic; a still-positive candidate result invalidates the logic. List every unproved transfer to density, host, parameter, target class, or asymptotics and ensure none is claimed.
joints.coordinator_expected_break: A cold capacity result could be misdescribed as an IC or ECDLP advance.

blind_rederivation.quantity: All 24 candidate/rho ratios, median and fixed bootstrap; candidate/baseline secondary wall, CPU and RSS values.
blind_rederivation.method: Use only hash-pinned case manifest, raw wait4/process receipts and protocol. Derive with Python random.Random('CSIC53-CAPACITY-BOOT-v1') before reading producer analysis.
